description: Shrink a scanned PDF from freedailypro by turning pages into pure black-and-white JBIG2 pictures, each page coded exactly as read (no letter is ever swapped; safe for contracts and numbers). Colour and shading are lost and text on converted pages is no longer selectable. A page is converted only when that makes it at least 10% smaller; other pages (for example real-text pages) are copied untouched. Errors if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected, over 100 pages, or if no smaller file results.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

name: pdf_compress_lossless_bw
